title: hearth nozzle

sections.heading: Decision details
sections.text:
You see a hearth nozzle.
How to use: Carry it beside your installed burning hearth. Choose a cell to direct heat from its inventory menu or that cell's C menu.
Needs: five hearth fuel per use.
Cost and limits: One action. Shared heat thaws ice and can ignite coatings; connected fires and nearby occupants remain at risk. Melted coatings are not drinking water.
Right now you can: direct hearth heat to 39,9 (5 fuel, 1 action), direct hearth heat to 39,10 (5 fuel, 1 action), direct hearth heat to 39,11 (5 fuel, 1 action), direct hearth heat to 40,9 (5 fuel, 1 action) and 4 more.

An iron throat in a clay jacket. Directs heat from an adjacent burning hearth, spending five fuel per use.
1 unit. Weight per unit: 2. Total weight: 2.
Lift Strength: 2; yours: 70.
